messages.subject: postdoc position on bird phenotypes
parts:
Dear geomorph-ers,

We are advertising for a new postdoc to join our Villum Synergy-funded project on Stochastic Morphometry! This 2-year position at the University of Copenhagen, Denmark, will focus on linking genotypes to phenotypes in birds, using whole-genome data from the B10K project, combined with 3D morphology from markmybird.org, MorphoSource, and other sources.

The project will be carried out in close collaboration with a dynamic team of researchers working on the mathematics of differential geometry and shape transformation, and biologists working on computational genomics and phylogenetics (~15 group members). The position will be supervised by myself and Rasmus Nielsen, with potential research stays at UC Berkeley.

See the full advert here for more information, or contact me directly with any questions.

Best,
Christy

Dr Christy Anna Hipsley | Associate Professor
Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen
